report.auditor_details: R.G.N. Price & Co. are the Statutory Auditors. The Independent Auditor's Report for the standalone financial statements (page 234) and consolidated financial statements (page 314) expresses an unmodified opinion, though it includes an 'Emphasis of Matter' regarding the implementation of the Cauvery Basin Refinery cum Petrochemical Complex.
report.rpt_summary: The company engages in various transactions with its holding company, Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL), and joint ventures like Indian Additives Limited and Cauvery Basin Refinery and Petrochemicals Limited (CBRPL). These include sales of products, purchase of raw materials, and other operational transactions (pages 191, 192, 296, 297).
report.contingent_liabilities: Contingent liabilities amount to ₹720.28 Crore as of 31st March 2025, primarily related to disputed demands from Central Excise/Customs/Service Tax authorities (₹589.48 Crore), VAT/Sales Tax (₹10.27 Crore), project-related suits (₹45.78 Crore), and other claims (₹74.75 Crore) (page 295).
report.capital_allocation: The company has invested ₹680.82 crore in CAPEX for FY 2024-25, focusing on projects like the Group II/III LOBS project (₹1,620 crore) and retail outlet expansion (page 52, 58, 143).
report.mgmt_compensation: The remuneration of whole-time functional directors is determined by the Government of India. Details for FY 2024-25 are provided on page 121.
report.equity_dilution: No equity dilution occurred during the year 2024-25 (page 139).
report.litigation: The company is involved in various tax and legal disputes, including a levy of ₹73.68 crore by the Tamilnadu Pollution Control Board (TNPCB) regarding an oil spill, which is currently contested before the National Green Tribunal (NGT) (page 223, 311).

red_flags.description: Non-compliance with board composition requirements, specifically regarding the minimum number of independent directors and the appointment of a woman independent director.
red_flags.evidence: The company did not have the minimum number of Independent Directors required... and does not have any Woman Director on the Board, as required by the above regulations, from 1st May 2024.

citation.quote: However, the company has received notices from NSE and BSE regarding Non- Appointment of requisite number of Independent Directors including One Woman Independent Director/Woman Director and with regard to Composition of NRC with less than 2/3rd Independent Directors throughout the year and for non-compliance w.r.t composition of Audit Committee, Nomination & Remuneration Committee, Stakeholders Relationship Committee, and Risk Management Committee from 16.11.2024 till 27.03.2025.

red_flags.description: Environmental compensation levied by the Tamilnadu Pollution Control Board (TNPCB) for an oil spill.
red_flags.evidence: The Tamilnadu Pollution Control Board (TNPCB) has passed an order in February 2025 levying environmental compensation of ₹ 73.68 crore for the environmental and socio-economic damages alleged to be caused due to the oil spill occurred during Michaung cyclone in December 2023.
